chapters.title: Thorax I: Mediastinum, Pericardium, Heart & Great Vessels
learning_objectives: Describe the gross anatomy of the heart, pericardium and great vessels, using standard anatomical terminology.
Relate cardiac structure to function, including valve action, coronary supply and the conducting system.
Apply cardiac anatomy to clinical scenarios such as myocardial infarction, heart block, tamponade and valve disease.
Interpret basic radiological and cross-sectional images of the thorax and heart.

other_chapters_note: Learning objectives for the remaining 99 chapters have not been authored.
